notes.title: Huge News
notes.content:
Dear friends and fellow gamers,

I hope this message finds you well. Today, I wanted to take a moment to express my deep gratitude for your support as I embarked on the incredible journey of creating my first video game. It has been an unforgettable experience, and your engagement has meant the world to me.

From the very start, my primary goal was never to profit from this venture. Instead, I aimed to share a piece of my creativity with all of you, to offer a source of entertainment and enjoyment. It fills my heart with joy to announce that the game from now on is  available for free to anyone who wishes to play it.

I would like to share with you a little backstory with you. Since my goal was never to profit from this game all the money I got I gave it to homeless individuals in need. I do not have any proof about that because I wasn't filming anything. I believe that acts of kindness and generosity are most meaningful when they are done without the expectation of recognition or filming. 

This game, being my first creation, was a test phase, a learning curve, as I ventured into the world of game development. Your feedback, whether positive or critical, has been incredibly valuable in helping me grow and improve as a developer. I appreciate each and every one of you who took the time to play the game and share your thoughts.

And now, I'm excited to share a little teaser for what's to come. My second game is currently in development, and I can confidently say that it's going to blow everyone away. I've poured my heart and soul into it, building upon the lessons I've learned from my first endeavor. I can't wait to share it with all of you when it's ready.

Thank you once again for your support, encouragement, and feedback. You are all an integral part of this journey, and I'm grateful to have you by my side. Together, we'll continue to make the gaming world a more exciting and enjoyable place.


Warm regards
Nemanja Ranitovic

notes.title: Lonely Now is OUT NOW
notes.content:
I am delighted to announce that Lonely Knight is available now on PC.

The game has been created by 1 man.

Lonely Knight is an action-adventure game set in medieval and ancient times. You are playing as a hero whose name is Tristan. Tristan's former friend Garreth, seized his wife so he could return to the army. After capturing Nyneve, Tristan felt betrayed and decided to go on an unexpected journey through dangerous lands.


[b]Minimum Pc Specs:[/b]

OS: Windows 64 bit only
Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200
Memory: 8 GB RAM
Graphics: Radeon RTX 550
DirectX: Version 11
Storage: 14 GB available space
Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

notes.title: Lonely Knight Coming to PC
notes.content:
Hi everyone. Nemanja here, developer of Lonely Knight. Today is a super exciting day in my life, I'm bringing you news you have been anxiously waiting for!

NR Studio is delighted to announce that Lonely Knight is coming on PC in  April 2022, to be more precise 6th April 2022.

The game has been created by 1 man, that would be me (25 years old dude), so I wanted to share with you my imagination and creativity. My dream has always been to open my game development studio and create my own game.
So, finally, my dream is going to be fulfilled with the help of you guys, you motivated me to continue with my work as I was posting those pictures on Reddit and discord. Because of that, I want to thank you, from the bottom of my heart for your kind words.

I hope you will like the game Lonely Knight as I do.

Best of luck. 

NR Studio is looking forward to seeing your reactions and gameplay on YouTube.
